resources.string: How to Add Quick Settings Tile
1. Swipe down twice from the top of your screen to fully open Quick Settings.
2. Tap the pencil or Edit icon (or three dots → Edit buttons).
3. Find the "Volume" tile in available tiles and drag it into your active tiles.

On ColorOS, Realme UI, and similar devices, manually exclude this app from battery optimization in Settings → Battery → App battery management → Allow background activity so the system does not kill the tile service.
